package natsdemo

import (
	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

func PublishGreeting(nc *nats.Conn) error {
	return nc.Publish("hello.greeting", []byte("hi"))
}

func PublishOrder(nc *nats.Conn) error {
	return nc.PublishMsg(&nats.Msg{
		Subject: "order.created",
		Data:    []byte("v"),
	})
}

func SubscribeGreetings(nc *nats.Conn) error {
	_, err := nc.Subscribe("hello.greeting", func(m *nats.Msg) {})
	return err
}

func QueueSubscribeWorkers(nc *nats.Conn) error {
	_, err := nc.QueueSubscribe("worker.jobs", "workers", func(m *nats.Msg) {})
	return err
}
